purpose: Advisory session candidate snapshots with configurable 30-minute reuse, explicit refresh, and lossless composed-command refusal propagation
scope: Fresh CLI processes against disposable local bare remotes. Empty ledger in measured commands; no real workspace, Story approval or model invocation. OS/executable caches were not flushed.

behavior.settings: Shared machine/workspace repository-check preferences, VS Code Repository Check Mode / Interval Minutes, or SINGULARITY_FLOW_REPOSITORY_CHECK_MODE / SINGULARITY_FLOW_REPOSITORY_CHECK_INTERVAL_MINUTES.
behavior.cacheScope: Complete advisory candidate lists only, including URL-only listings. Exact cwd/selectors, settings, build/environment and local dependency fingerprints bind reuse. Legacy JSON remains an array.
behavior.firstLocalRead: A complete verified local state index may seed the initial advisory listing without network; source local and remoteCheckedAt null are never represented as a fresh remote observation.
behavior.failure: No failure/incomplete roster is cached as a success. Explicit refresh invalidates the older observation. Expired/corrupt snapshots and Always mode use the remote verifier; they do not fall back to first-use local seeding.
behavior.authority: Attachment, Story/phase binding, source integrity, publication, tests, submission and approval retain their fresh owners. No application branch/history scan or automatic retry was added.
behavior.transport: Preserves the underlying code, message and recovery packet across table/text/JSON composed steps, even with a debug trailer. Closed state transport evidence includes observation/fetch stage, classification, exit/signal, logical/process deadline and elapsed time. Raw provider stderr is not copied; timeouts are not inferred DNS failures. An early packet or late zero exit cannot erase a process timeout.
behavior.refreshRace: An explicit VS Code refresh is scheduled after an older in-flight advisory read instead of silently joining it.

qualification.staticChecks: 2709 checks across 179 skills passed; existing vocabulary advisories only.
qualification.gitBypassAudit: 1788 reviewed production process/Git sites; no unreviewed new sites.
qualification.bundleBudget: Passed. Lazy-panel byte ceiling increased by 500 bytes (3094000 to 3094500) for refresh routing; its 249-module ceiling and all other ceilings remain unchanged. No gateway module-ceiling increase.
qualification.testMaintenance: The existing session-open parity test now excludes only independently observed check timestamp/age after validating their types; it still compares the semantic packet. The existing 5ms process-cleanup fixture was given a 1000ms launch window so Windows Git setup cannot consume the entire deadline before its fake child starts. Signal, timeout, late-zero-exit and cleanup-bound assertions remain.

Candidate diagnostics retain WORK_SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH: source.json differs from the immutable Story source snapshot. Listing, selection and strict attachment complete before this distinct prompt-integrity refusal. The underlying byte difference was not investigated or normalized in this caching change.
knownBaselineFailures.handling: Integrity validation is unchanged and not bypassed. The final scoped Windows run retains the passing native discovery UI probe; it is not a claim that this broader handoff probe passed.

limitations: Small local-remotes fixtures, not office proxy/credential/antivirus or cloud-offloaded storage qualification.
Before/after samples run sequentially and vary with host load. A new process is not a flushed OS or Node compile cache.
The first repeat may be a local-index cache fill, not a cache hit; snapshot identifies which. Both local and cache rows avoid remote work.
Repeated Windows source cache hit was 967ms versus the corresponding baseline 1697ms in the final sample, with zero Git/remote calls; this is a sample, not an SLA.
Mac source wall-clock samples did not consistently improve even though cached Git/remote counts were zero. Candidate installed-layout measurements have no matched installed-layout baseline here.

Cold setup is not removed. The first uncached attempt can add a local-index probe before remote discovery (29 Git calls versus baseline 23); first-download timings must not be described as a universal speedup.
Real authentication/TLS failures and source-integrity failures remain refusals. Cached browsing cannot repair remote access or authorize a mutation.
Temporary hosted CI workflow files are confined to the CI branch and are never merged into production.
